hook: Your clock says midnight, and the sun is up.
title: Midnight on Your Clock, Sun in the Sky
description:
In Tromsø, Norway, the sun does not set for roughly two months in summer. The city sits north of the Arctic Circle, and Earth's tilt keeps it facing the sun. Midnight can look like noon.

#Shorts #MidnightSun #Norway
comment_prompt: Could you sleep here? Yes or no
